scope: Monte Carlo draws and tactical clash sweep failures

behavior.monte_carlo: Thrown simulator exceptions include only their bounded class; returned error results use a fixed summary while retaining draw indexes and failure counts.
behavior.clash_sweep: Failed scenario details contain only the scenario label and bounded exception class; the sweep continues.

coverage: failing draw exception contents are omitted
clash-sweep malformed input details are omitted
existing distribution and resolution behavior remains covered

limitations: This does not validate domain assumptions or outcomes against populated operational data.
